subject: self-correct-engine

metrics.name: self_correct.py — auto-correction engine
triggers: Multiple failed runs in same axis
actions: Auto-revert to last known-good bank weight
Post correction card to corrections ledger
If 3 reverts in 24h → escalate to owner
metrics.doctrine: Corrections are structural, not shameful. 48 corrections to date = body that publishes when it's wrong.
metrics.owner_gate: If 3 reverts in 24h, owner reviews. Otherwise fully autonomous.

honest_sentence: self_correct.py: triggers on accuracy drop, leader change, corruption, multiple fails. Auto-revert + post correction + re-run. 3 reverts/24h → owner review. Fully autonomous otherwise.
